# PDF HTML5 Page Flip Pro - Comprehensive Reference & API Manual

Website: https://flipbook.apps.gracer.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/iamapinan/pdf-html5-page-flip
Author: Apinan Worawichitsilp (@iamapinan)
License: Apache-2.0

## Architectural Overview
PDF HTML5 Page Flip Pro is designed from the ground up for zero-latency, private, client-side document presentation.
1. Rendering Engine: Mozilla PDF.js runs in dedicated background Web Workers, parsing raw binary PDF byte streams directly into GPU-accelerated HTML5 canvases.
2. 3D Turning Simulation: CSS 3D transforms with custom cubic-bezier easing deliver natural page curl, depth shadow gradients, and spine crease effects.
3. Audio Synthesis: The Web Audio API procedurally synthesizes realistic multi-layer white-noise filtered paper friction sounds on flip events without loading audio assets.
4. Memory Virtualization: Visible pages are rendered at full devicePixelRatio, while distant pages are culled to prevent browser memory leaks on multi-hundred-page documents.

## React Component Props (<PdfFlipbook />)
- src (string, required): Local path or remote URL to PDF file.
- className (string, optional): Additional wrapper CSS classes.
- showToolbar (boolean, default true): Toggle floating toolbar.
- showOutline (boolean, default true): Toggle PDF outline/bookmark drawer.
- showSearch (boolean, default true): Toggle full-text search drawer.
- showThumbnail (boolean, default true): Toggle thumbnail strip.
- showPageNumber (boolean, default true): Toggle interactive page number counter.
- showZoom (boolean, default true): Toggle zoom controls (In/Out/Fit/Reset).
- showFullscreen (boolean, default true): Toggle fullscreen toggle.
- showPrint (boolean, default true): Toggle full-document printing.
- showSound (boolean, default true): Toggle synthesized page-flip sound toggle.
- showThemePicker (boolean, default true): Toggle theme selector (Dark, Light, Wood).
- showAiSummary (boolean, default true): Toggle AI Document Summarizer.
- accentColor (string, default '#f43f5e'): Primary accent brand color (Hex).
- theme ('dark' | 'light' | 'wood', default 'light'): Default visual canvas theme.
- initialPage (number, default 1): Starting page number.
- onPageChange ((current: number, total: number) => void): Page navigation callback.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: Does PDF HTML5 Page Flip Pro transmit documents to a cloud server?
A: No. All parsing and rendering execute completely inside the client browser. No document data is ever sent across the network.

Q: Can I use this in Next.js App Router (SSR)?
A: Yes. Import with dynamic import `next/dynamic` with `{ ssr: false }` since PDF.js relies on browser window and canvas APIs.
